name: world_model
description: Causal world model. Maintains a structured representation of how the world works -- entities, their properties, causal relationships, and transition dynamics. Enables counterfactual reasoning ('what would happen if...').

neural_component.description: Learned dynamics model for continuous/fuzzy predictions

symbolic_component.description: Explicit causal graph for structured/logical predictions

forward_simulation.description: Predict next state given current state + action

counterfactual.description: What would have happened if action X instead of Y?

abductive.description: What action/cause best explains this observed state?
